wire.artifact: dataset grant v1 signed payloads and tokens
wire.note: The tokens are exact: Ed25519 is deterministic, so test-only-grant-key.pk8 signs each payload to one token, and both producers must write it. The payloads under invalid/ are signed by the test, so every negative vector is validly signed and its refusal is a claim-check result; refusal names the GrantError variant the verifier returns for it.
